about.paragraph1: I'm a passionate software engineer with over 5 years of experience crafting digital products that make a difference. My journey started with a curiosity for how things work on the web, and it has evolved into a deep expertise in modern frontend technologies.
about.paragraph2: When I'm not coding, you'll find me exploring new technologies, contributing to open-source projects, or sharing knowledge with the developer community.

lumap.description: A full-stack web platform that streamlines industrial operations by managing customers, quotations, work orders, production workflow, and financial processes with real-time tracking.

barberFlow.title: Barber Flow
barberFlow.description: Barber Flow is a complete solution for the financial and operational management of your barbershop. It allows you to track daily, weekly, and monthly revenue in detail, as well as monitor each barber's individual earnings. The software also distinguishes between one-time paid haircuts and services provided to clients subscribed to a monthly plan, giving a clear view of the profitability of each model.

driveHub.title: Drive Hub
driveHub.description: A React and TypeScript frontend project for organizing and presenting vehicle-related information through a clean, responsive interface.

planeGraphAnalysis.title: Plane Graph Analysis
planeGraphAnalysis.description: An automated pipeline that mines developer interactions (comments, issue closures, and code reviews) from the Plane repository (makeplane/plane) to build a collaboration network. It uses a custom graph structure (AdjacencyListGraph/AdjacencyMatrixGraph) built from scratch, computes centrality metrics (PageRank, Brandes' Betweenness, Wasserman & Faust Closeness), detects communities via Label Propagation, and exports the data for interactive visual analysis in Gephi or on the web with Sigma.js.
